note: Chapter 1 is keyed from 'is cleared' (Vertonghen's hook) and 'Son Heung-min' (his first touch) through 'Off he goes', 'Past one', 'past two', 'he's still going', 'into the box' to 'goal' (the ball crossing the line): keep the pauses at '...' so the run plays near real time.

chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: London, 2019. A Burnley free kick is cleared to Son Heung-min, by his own box. Off he goes! Past one... past two... he's still going, into the box... goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Long touches push the ball into space, so he sprints at full speed, head up.

chapters.label: Past Nick Pope
chapters.text: He skips a tackle, races into the box, and slots it past Nick Pope with his right foot. Puskás Award goal!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: when there's space, carry the ball with long touches, run at full speed, and keep your head up.
